purpose: Define one deterministic and fail-closed construction protocol for a future numerical C-PHYS-M1 candidate background. This contract neither supplies a parameter instance nor executes a nonlinear solve.

frozen_mathematical_problem.regional_coordinate: tau in [0,1] for each of N and S

required_before_execution: all tolerances and mesh levels from this preregistration

primary_discretization.profile_unknown_layout: four regularized profiles per region at all collocation nodes plus eight augmented variables
primary_discretization.endpoint_treatment: bulk equations at interior nodes; pole regularity encoded by affine tau chart; eight cap/global conditions supplied by B
primary_discretization.reason: Fixed node levels prevent post-result mesh tuning and permit direct convergence auditing.

nonlinear_method.jacobian: algorithmic differentiation or exact complex-step equivalent declared before execution
nonlinear_method.linear_solver: rank-revealing QR primary with SVD diagnostic

deterministic_seed_protocol.seed_generation: fixed low-order parity-chart coefficient templates generated solely from the frozen run-input hash
deterministic_seed_protocol.mesh_prolongation: accepted lower-order candidate interpolated to the next preregistered node level
deterministic_seed_protocol.multiple_converged_candidates: retain and report every distinct candidate; no lowest-residual cherry-pick
deterministic_seed_protocol.distinctness_threshold: max normalized profile-plus-augmented-vector distance greater than 1e-6

normalization_and_norms.bulk_component_scaling: unit dimensionless scaling; every component also reported separately
normalization_and_norms.boundary_component_scaling: unit dimensionless scaling; every component also reported separately
normalization_and_norms.bulk_norm: maximum absolute collocation residual over all regions, components and enforced bulk nodes
normalization_and_norms.boundary_norm: maximum absolute value over the eight ordered boundary residuals
normalization_and_norms.constraint_norm: maximum absolute normalized C_rr value evaluated at all collocation nodes
normalization_and_norms.profile_difference_norm: maximum absolute difference after interpolation to the finer common tau grid

convergence_requirements.residual_monotonicity: bulk, boundary and constraint norms may not increase from N=48 to 64 or from 64 to 96 by more than a factor 1.25
convergence_requirements.spectral_coefficient_audit: last eight modal coefficients of each profile must decrease overall and their maximum magnitude must be below 1e-9 at N=96

independent_backend_requirement.allowed_backend: fourth-order finite-difference or independent Lobatto collocation implementation with separately coded residual assembly
independent_backend_requirement.required_grid_resolution: at least 2x129 finite-difference points or equivalent

predeclared_result_classes.interpretation_limit: None of these classes proves continuum existence, uniqueness, Fredholmness, stability or physical viability.

mandatory_run_artifacts: discrete singular values and condition estimates labeled diagnostic
forbidden_next_action: Do not execute the solver until a separate versioned Background-3B run-input contract freezes one exact parameter and topology instance.
